message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff. The first thing they learned was how to mix mortar from local clay and sand. They spent days watching the human masons at work, observing every technique. The villagers were initially wary of this strange forest creature among them. But Pebble Spring proved to be helpful, fixing roofs and reinforcing walls. Slowly, the people began to accept their presence in the village. They took on a small cottage as their first project. The foundation laid with great care, each stone placed with precision. The arcane magic in their staff helped the stones bond together perfectly. The walls rose steadily over the course of two weeks. They added a roof of thatched reeds, just as the villagers did. The cottage was small but sturdy, and it pleased them greatly. Word spread quickly through the village about the Leshy builder. Other families began to request their help with repairs and new builds. Pebble Spring worked tirelessly, day and night, under the moonlight. The magic from the staff made the work faster than any human mason. They developed a unique style that blended natural wood with stone. The houses they built seemed to breathe with the forest around them. Even the elders of the village praised the quality of their work. Pebble Spring felt a deep sense of purpose they had never known before. After many attempts at crafting the perfect foundation for the new structure they had been diligently working on for several long weeks in the small quiet village of Thornwood the resulting pattern on the spotty walls was a source of great frustration for Pebble Spring.
